title: GRP-Obliteration: Unaligning LLMs With a Single Unlabeled Prompt
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical process of removing safety alignment (unalignment) from large language and image generation models. While it evaluates safety benchmarks that include categories like 'illegal acts' or 'ethical noncompliance' as defined by model providers, it does not specifically investigate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or theological frameworks.
